prompt:
Image 1 is a pixel-art sprite sheet of a small empty-handed chibi knight running in two diagonal views for a top-down 2D game. Image 2 shows the same knight's one-handed slash motion from the front, the side and the back. Create ONE NEW sheet of the same slash motion in the two diagonal views. Keep exactly the same character, armour, helmet, size, proportions, palette, dark outline and pixel-art style.

The knight carries nothing. Both hands are empty closed brown leather gloves, clearly visible and not overlapping the helmet.

Layout: exactly 2 rows and 3 columns on a completely flat solid pure magenta background, RGB 255,0,255. Every character is the same size as in Image 1 and centred in an evenly spaced grid cell, with clear magenta space around them.

Row 1: facing diagonally toward the viewer and to the right, three-quarter front view.
Row 2: facing diagonally away from the viewer and to the right, three-quarter back view. The face is not visible.

Column 1, wind-up: the right arm is pulled back and raised, the feet are planted apart.
Column 2, strike: the right arm is thrown forward at full reach in the direction the knight faces, the front foot steps forward.
Column 3, follow-through: the right arm has swept across to the other side of the body and is low.

Do not include: swords, weapons, shields, text, labels, numbers, grid lines, ground, shadows, dust, motion lines, effects, borders, watermark, or any other object. No soft gradients, blur or painterly rendering.
